en.name: Spoilers and Readings
en.description: Shows ||a spoiler|| covered until you point at it, and {漢字|かんじ} with its reading above the words. The text stays as you wrote it.
en.walk.title: Getting Started
en.walk.spoilerHow: Type /spoiler, or put the words between || and ||. Point at them to read them.
en.walk.rubyHow: Write {漢字|かんじ}: the words, a bar, then their reading.

zh.name: 剧透与注音
zh.description: 把 ||剧透|| 遮住，指上去才显示；把 {漢字|かんじ} 的读音标在字上方。原文保持不变。
zh.walk.title: 上手
zh.walk.spoilerHow: 输入 /剧透，或者把文字放在 || 和 || 之间。指上去就能看到。
zh.walk.rubyHow: 写成 {漢字|かんじ}：文字、竖线，再写读音。
